scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w backend
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src backend/src/*.js backend/scripts backend/tests *.json frontend/*.js
scripts.test:pwa: npm run build && npm run test:pwa -w frontend
scripts.docker:admin: docker compose exec app npm run create-admin
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec app npm run seed
